name: product-discovery
description: Product discovery and prototyping workflows: Supersprint with a growing discovery tree, public customer research, affinity mapping, desk research, interview planning, data analysis, concrete experiment design, and art-directed landing pages.

interface.longDescription: Superhero Skills combines discovery and design in one plugin. Supersprint guides a saved discovery cycle with a growing HTML/Mermaid tree, using the included public customer research, affinity mapping, desk research, interview planning, data analysis and experiment-design skills. Product Design builds distinctive landing pages through a guided brief, independent art direction and visual iteration.
defaultPrompt: Research this product decision and challenge my assumptions.
Synthesize these interview transcripts with affinity mapping.
Build a distinctive landing page with a guided brief and independent art direction.
